# templates/affiliate-one-pager.md

# DigiRoo Clinician Partner Program — one page

**Screen Time, Elevated.**

## The problem you already talk about
Kids hunch over tablets. You explain it to parents every week: the lower the screen, the further the head drops forward, the more load on a growing neck. Parents nod, go home, and the iPad goes right back on their kid's lap.

## What DigiRoo is
A protective kids' iPad case with a patented, height-adjustable stand built in. It lifts the screen up to 4.4 inches and tilts up to 60°, with 25+ positions, so the screen comes up to the child's eyes instead of the child's neck going down to the screen. BPA-free, drop-friendly, fits iPad 10.2" (7th–9th gen; 10th-gen version available). Fast Company Innovation by Design 2022, Honourable Mention. Designed by a Bermuda mom, Antonia Holder.

## What you get
| | |
|---|---|
| **Free unit** | One DigiRoo for your clinic or waiting room, shipped free. |
| **Your code** | e.g. `DRSMITH10`: families get 10% off at kidsdigitalwellness.com; you earn **15% commission** on every order, paid monthly. |
| **Content pack** | Three short posture-education videos (20 s, 10 s, 25 s) with captions, ready to post as-is or with a 5-second intro from you. Parent-friendly, no medical claims, your handle and code on every end card. |
| **Parent handout** | Optional one-page "screen posture at home" PDF with your clinic's name on it. |
| **Zero admin** | No minimums, no contract, no reporting. Reply "stop" to end anytime. |

## How it works
1. Say yes → tell us pink or blue + an address.
2. Unit arrives in about a week with your code card.
3. Mention it when posture comes up, hand out the card, post the content if you like.
4. We send a short monthly note: orders with your code, your commission, and new content.

## Why clinics like it
- It gives you **something concrete to recommend** after the "sit up straight" conversation.
- The content is **yours to use**, which fills a posting slot without you filming anything.
- It's a **habit tool**, not a medical device. We never make treatment claims, so there's nothing for you to defend.

**Contact:** Antonia Holder · antonia@kidsdigitalwellness.com (⚠️ confirm) · @digiroocase · kidsdigitalwellness.com

## Block 1 — {{location}} · {{talent}} · {{minutes}} min
**Set up once:** {{setup_one_line}} (e.g. phone upright on a mug on the coffee table, side-on to her, at her head height; tap her face, hold for AE/AF lock; don't touch it again)
**Good looks like:** {{good_looks_like}} (e.g. her head to her lap and the iPad in frame; the top quarter empty for the title)

| Post | Take | What happens | Say | ~min |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| {{post_id}} | one take | record → 5 s of slouch → pop the stand from the side → 5 s upright → your line → 3 s → stop. Twice. | (off-camera) "{{line}}" | 3 |

**With her:** don't ask her to slouch; start rolling 20–30 s into her show. Never ask her to look at the camera. If she notices it, keep rolling.

## Block 2 — {{location}} · Antonia only · {{minutes}} min
**Set up once:** front camera at your eye level (books), arm's length, eyes on the top grid line, plain wall behind, TV/AC off.
| Post | Line | Say (each line twice, a breath between) | ~min |
|---|---|---|---|
| | | | |

| Post | Script |
|---|---|
| | |

## B-roll while you're set up (10 min)
- Hands raising the stand, 3 heights, hold each 2 s
- Close-ups as their own clips: hinge, handle, both colours
- {{founder_broll}}

---

## After (5 min)
1. Send everything: AirDrop to the Mac (`media/raw/{{week}}/<post-id>/`), the Drive folder, or attach in the chat. Don't trim, rename or filter.
2. Say **check my clips** while she's still around. Redoing a dark or sideways take now takes 2 minutes.
